WITH requirement_history AS ( SELECT ms.account_id,ap.account_ingredient_product_id, AVG(r.quantity) average_required_qty, COUNT(*) menu_usage_count, MAX(ms.meal_date) last_used_at FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_id=ms.account_id AND ap.account_ingredient_product_id=r.account_ingredient_product_id WHERE ms.status='COMPLETED' AND r.reversed_at IS NULL AND ms.meal_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE,INTERVAL COALESCE(#{average_days},30) DAY) AND ms.meal_date<=CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY ms.account_id,ap.account_ingredient_product_id ) SELECT b.*,COALESCE(b.current_unit,b.base_unit) current_unit, ROUND(COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)*1.10,3) safe_stock_base_qty, ap.max_stock_base_qty,ap.lead_time_days, COALESCE(b.location_id,ap.default_location_id,'L999') location_id, ap.mapped_ingredient_id ingredient_id,COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw,im.ingredient_name_std,im.ingredient_name_raw,p.product_name) ingredient_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(ai.category_name,''),im.category_name) category_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(ai.storage_type,''),im.storage_type) storage_type, p.image_url,p.thumbnail_url,p.product_name,p.supplier_item_code,p.order_unit, COALESCE(ap.link_base_qty,p.base_qty) package_base_qty,s.supplier_name,ph.purchase_price,
CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_movement mv WHERE mv.account_id=b.account_id AND mv.account_ingredient_product_id=b.account_ingredient_product_id AND mv.movement_type<>'ADJUST') THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END opening_available, COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0) average_usage_qty,rh.last_used_at, COALESCE(rh.menu_usage_count,0) menu_usage_count, ap.max_stock_base_qty total_capacity_qty,ROUND(COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0),3) required_qty, ROUND(GREATEST(COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)-b.current_base_qty,0),3) shortage_qty, ROUND(GREATEST(COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)*1.10-b.current_base_qty,0),3) order_needed_qty, (SELECT rd.menu_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd WHERE rd.account_id=b.account_id AND rd.ingredient_id=ap.mapped_ingredient_id ORDER BY rd.menu_id LIMIT 1) menu_id, (SELECT am.menu_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master am ON am.account_id=rd.account_id AND am.menu_id=rd.menu_id WHERE rd.account_id=b.account_id AND rd.ingredient_id=ap.mapped_ingredient_id AND am.del_yn='N' ORDER BY rd.menu_id LIMIT 1) menu_name, CASE WHEN b.current_base_qty<=0 AND COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)>0 THEN 'RED' WHEN b.current_base_qty<=0 THEN 'EMPTY' WHEN b.current_base_qty<COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0) THEN 'ORANGE' WHEN rh.last_used_at IS NULL AND ap.max_stock_base_qty>0 AND b.current_base_qty/ap.max_stock_base_qty<=0.30 THEN 'YELLOW' WHEN COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)<=0 THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'GREEN' END stock_status FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance b JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_ingredient_product_id=b.account_ingredient_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master ai ON ai.account_id=b.account_id AND ai.ingredient_id=ap.mapped_ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master im ON im.ingredient_id=ap.mapped_ingredient_id
LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_price ph ON ph.supplier_price_id=( SELECT ph2.supplier_price_id FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_price ph2 JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer so2 ON so2.supplier_offer_id=ph2.supplier_offer_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site ss2 ON ss2.supplier_account_site_id=so2.supplier_account_site_id WHERE ss2.account_id=b.account_id AND ss2.active_yn='Y' AND so2.supplier_product_id=p.supplier_product_id AND so2.active_yn='Y' AND ph2.effective_from<=NOW() AND (ph2.effective_to IS NULL OR ph2.effective_to>NOW()) ORDER BY ss2.last_synced_at DESC,ph2.effective_from DESC,ph2.supplier_price_id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN requirement_history rh ON rh.account_id=b.account_id AND rh.account_ingredient_product_id=b.account_ingredient_product_id WHERE b.account_id=#{account_id} AND b.inventory_balance_id=#{inventory_balance_id} ORDER BY FIELD(stock_status,'RED','EMPTY','ORANGE','YELLOW','UNKNOWN','GREEN'),p.product_name

SELECT i.ingredient_id,COALESCE(i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name, i.ingredient_name_raw,i.ingredient_name_std,i.category_name,i.base_unit,i.storage_type, i.menu_usage_count,i.needs_review,i.note FROM the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i WHERE 1=1 AND i.ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id} ORDER BY i.category_name,ingredient_name

SELECT p.order_unit,COALESCE(ap.link_base_qty,p.base_qty) pack_qty,COALESCE(ap.link_base_unit,p.base_unit) pack_unit FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id WHERE ap.account_ingredient_product_id=#{account_ingredient_product_id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_movement WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND account_ingredient_product_id=#{account_ingredient_product_id} AND movement_type<>'ADJUST'
